usedFor: Each Google Ads lead form submission opens a deal in HubSpot.

bestTemplate.name: “New Lead Form Submitted” in Google Ads, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Google Ads pushes the submission as it happens, and “Create Deal” puts it in the pipeline.

watchOut: A fresh ad lead has no ID for “Update Deal” or “Update Company”, so start with “Create Deal”.
